[V14.2.3](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/4.0/en/0x22-V14-Config.md#v142-dependency)

- "CSS" = "Cascading Style Sheets"
- "CSS stylesheets" = "Cascading Style Sheets stylesheets"

Current:
> V14.2.3 Verify that if application assets, such as JavaScript libraries, **CSS stylesheets or web fonts**, are hosted externally on a **content delivery network** (CDN) or external provider, Subresource Integrity (SRI) is used to validate the integrity of the asset. 

Proposal:
> V14.2.3 Verify that if application assets, such as JavaScript libraries, **CSS or web font files**, are hosted externally on a **Content Delivery Network** (CDN) or external provider, Subresource Integrity (SRI) is used to validate the integrity of the asset.
